newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DC Finance says talks with GITIC halted.
newsitem.headline: DC Finance says talks with GITIC halted.

text.p: DC Finance (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday discussions with Guangdong International Trust & Investment Corp H.K. (Holdings) Ltd (GITIC) regarding an issue of new shares would not be pursued further.
"The discussions with Guangdong International Trust & Investment Corp H.K. (Holdings) Ltd regarding various proposals...did not have material developments," the company said in a statement.
"The company would not pursuit further with regard to the proposals," the statement said.

In February, DC Finance said the company was in discussions with GITIC, the holding company of GITIC Enterprises Ltd, regarding various proposals including a possible issue of new shares by the company.
DC Finance fell HK$0.04 to HK$1.57 in mid-morning.
